title: Maximum likelihood, neural networks and posterior mean for inferring fractional Brownian motion parameters
abstract: arXiv:2610.19888v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fractional Brownian motion (fBM) is a model of anomalous diffusion parameterised by a Hurst exponent $H \in (0,1)$ and a generalised diffusion coefficient $D_H > 0$. We jointly estimate $H$ and $D_H$ using maximum likelihood (MLE) from density measurements with Poisson counting noise and single-particle trajectory with Gaussian localisation error. We show that one density measurement in time cannot infer both $H$ and $D_H$ and that several time points are needed, which matters most for inference precision. For trajectories, we show that a neural network trained with a squared error loss approximates the posterior mean of $H$, which can be computed exactly at negligible cost. Paired with the profile-likelihood estimate of $D_H$, the posterior mean has the lowest root mean squared error in both $H$ and $D_H$, except near $H=0$ and $H=1$ where MLE estimates $H$ better. translated_title: 极大似然、神经网络与后验均值用于推断分数布朗运动参数
translated_abstract: 分数布朗运动（fBM）是一种异常扩散模型，由Hurst指数 $H \in (0,1)$ 和广义扩散系数 $D_H > 0$ 参数化。我们使用极大似然估计（MLE），从带有泊松计数噪声的密度测量数据以及带有高斯定位误差的单粒子轨迹数据中联合估计 $H$ 和 $D_H$。我们证明，单一时间点的密度测量无法同时推断 $H$ 和 $D_H$，需要多个时间点才能实现，这对推断精度至关重要。对于轨迹数据，我们证明使用平方误差损失训练的神经网络可以逼近 $H$ 的后验均值，而后验均值可以以可忽略的成本被精确计算。结合 $D_H$ 的轮廓似然估计，后验均值在 $H$ 和 $D_H$ 上均具有最低的均方根误差，除了在 $H=0$ 和 $H=1$ 附近，此时MLE能更好地估计 $H$。在来自两种细胞类型的囊泡轨迹数据中，$H$ 和 $D_H$ 形成一个连……
tldr: 该论文提出将极大似然估计与神经网络（经证明可逼近后验均值）相结合来联合估计分数布朗运动的Hurst指数和广义扩散系数，并表明后验均值结合轮廓似然估计在绝大多数情况下具有最低的均方根误差。
en_tdlr: This paper jointly infers the Hurst exponent and generalized diffusion coefficient of fractional Brownian motion using maximum likelihood and neural networks—shown to approximate the posterior mean—and demonstrates that the posterior mean paired with profile likelihood achieves the lowest root mean squared error except near H=0 and H=1.
